findings_addressed.oracle: Every ModelInfo in installed_models must have a non-empty id, a non-empty name, and provider==ProviderName.OLLAMA. These are independently derived from the _populate_ollama_models source (id=f'{id_prefix}{model_name}', name=f'{name_prefix}{model_name}', provider=ProviderName.OLLAMA). The fixture guarantee of non-empty list makes the loop non-vacuous.

Every ID in ids1 (from the fixture's first call) must start with 'local/' and have a non-empty suffix after that prefix. This oracle is derived from the _populate_ollama_models source contract (id=f'local/{model_name}'). Additionally ids1 must equal ids2 from the second call. The 'local/' prefix check is an independent oracle that a stateless mutation would break on the first call without needing to compare two calls.
